scope: Preserve the existing employee VersionRelease route and interactions while replacing its underlying backend.

authority.identity: Actual Native Cookie verification and SQL withActor identity mapping.
authority.expected_employee: Checked after real actor resolution and before release queries; never an authentication credential.
authority.backend: services/pg-api/src/original-version-release-http.ts -> actual AgentReleaseRepository and existing migration046 RPCs
authority.writes: Existing configuration-write and acceptance flags remain authoritative; the facade grants no new permissions.

actions.api: Original Home owner catalog and GET agent
actions.result: Read verified owner pages, validate totals and deduplicate; late old employee or selection responses cannot update the current view.
Use server next_version_no and active_version_id. History is explicitly partial: latest100 versions and10 acceptance entries.
Fetch active_version_id even outside the loaded history, then recheck source and release head before displaying it.
Require explicit task and cost acknowledgement, current owner model revision, source CAS and existing acceptance gate; create the actual server-owned run, without browser ticks.
awaiting_approval and awaiting_input remain live. Only test_current with matching source and revision proves the current configuration passed.
Use the current source revision/hash and a server-assigned version number. Only a current verified acceptance may be linked.
Recheck source, version and release-head CAS, current resources and explicit confirmation. Untested publication requires its separate explicit acknowledgement.
Require an8-500 character reason, current source/version CAS and current resource ownership/ACL checks; reuse the actual atomic restore transaction.
Require current version CAS and confirmation. Published versions cannot be deleted as drafts.
Read full owner snapshots including name, model, HTTP, MCP, knowledge and acceptance-model bindings. Missing details never mean identical configurations.

Persist only owner/action/IDs/revisions/hashes and request fingerprint in owner-scoped session storage. Exact GET confirmation checks the original fingerprint;404 remains uncertain and no POST is automatically replayed.

actions.api: Actual Native /me plus fresh workspace/resource reads
actions.result: Hide private content and disable actions while unknown. A newly verified same employee may recover in-memory inputs after context checks; verified signout, me401/me403, another employee and disposal permanently erase local private drafts. Late responses remain fenced.

actions.api: Actual owner model inventory plus fresh workspace and source reads
actions.result: Revalidate current model revisions, availability and source/head; clear stale fee/review confirmation, never silently rebind, preserve unsubmitted text, and reject late old initialization or inventory responses. Partial inventory does not establish model absence.

history_limits.publication_table: Loaded versions' last-publication state; not a complete publication-event ledger.

open_acceptance_gaps: Dedicated original /version-release genuine browser story has not run.
Actual employee Cookie, owner isolation, resource revocation, CAS/audit rollback and full restore must be verified on the original page with isolated PG.
Committed reply-prefix loss and matching browser requestfailed must be followed by GET-only exact receipt recovery for release mutations.
Acceptance through actual Worker, current-source pass, pending approval/input and return recovery still require end-to-end evidence.
Real employee UAT, target installation, backups/recovery/rollback and long-running Worker qualification remain open.
